about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Vogue ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Vogue was a flagship trim of the Range Rover, spanning the L322 (2001–2012) and L405 (2012–2021) generations. Across these generations, the Vogue was available with a choice of two diesel engine families: the 3.0-litre six-cylinder (TDV6/SDV6) and the 4.4-litre V8 (TDV8/SDV8). The Vogue trim was discontinued with the introduction of the L460 generation in 2022, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Land Rover Range Rover Vogue Engine Codes TDV6 (L322, L405) A 3.0-litre V6 diesel fitted to the Range Rover Vogue across both the L322 and L405 generations. Known for timing chain and injector wear over time — see the callout above. We replace these as standard on every TDV6 rebuild, along with EGR, turbo and gasket components. Check Your TDV6 Range Rover Vogue → [link to quote form] SDV6 (L322, L405) A higher-output 3.0-litre V6 diesel, also fitted across L322 and L405 generations. Shares the same timing chain and injector wear pattern as the TDV6. We service it to the same standard. Check Your SDV6 Range Rover Vogue → [link to quote form] TDV8 (L322, L405) A 4.4-litre V8 diesel fitted to the Range Rover Vogue across both generations. Known for the same timing chain and injector wear pattern as its six-cylinder siblings — this is a consistent trait across the engine family. Check Your TDV8 Range Rover Vogue → [link to quote form] SDV8 (L322, L405) A higher-output 4.4-litre V8 diesel, also fitted across L322 and L405 generations. Shares the same engine family traits as the TDV8. Check Your SDV8 Range Rover Vogue → [link to quote form] Land Rover Range Rover Vogue Engine Compatibility Because the Range Rover Vogue was available with multiple diesel engines across two generations, matching the correct engine to your car is critical. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (TDV6, SDV6, TDV8 or SDV8) via registration or VIN - Your generation (L322 or L405) - Ancillary and ECU specification specific to your exact build This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Range Rover Vogue quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car. We also cover: [Range Rover TDV6 Engine →] · [Range Rover SDV6 Engine →] · [Range Rover TDV8 Engine →] · [Range Rover SDV8 Engine →] · [Range Rover Autobiography Engine →] · [Range Rover D300/D350 Engine →] [← View All Land Rover Range Rover Engines] Frequently Asked Questions What engine does the Land Rover Range Rover Vogue use? It depends on the generation and year. The Range Rover Vogue (L322, 2001–2012, and L405, 2012–2021) was available with the TDV6 or SDV6 3.0-litre V6 diesel, or the TDV8 or SDV8 4.4-litre V8 diesel. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has. How much does a Land Rover Range Rover Vogue engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £2,400 for six-cylinder engines, and from £4,500 for V8 engines. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover Vogue? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have a TDV6, SDV6, TDV8 or SDV8 before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild TDV6 Range Rover Vogue engines? Yes. We replace timing chains, injector seals, EGR, turbo components and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 rebuild. Do you rebuild SDV6 Range Rover Vogue engines? Yes. The SDV6 shares the same engine family and wear pattern as the TDV6, and we service it to the same standard. Do you rebuild TDV8 Range Rover Vogue engines? Yes. The TDV8 V8 diesel shares the same timing chain and injector wear pattern as the six-cylinder engines, and we replace these components as standard. Do you rebuild SDV8 Range Rover Vogue engines? Yes. The SDV8 is the higher-output V8 in the same family, and we service it to the same standard. Do you supply used Range Rover Vogue engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Range Rover Vogue if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Range Rover Vogue engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Range Rover Vogue owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. codes.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Vogue ENGINE

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Vogue from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
